test_fetch_rcv1: test the fetch_rcv1 loader with shuffle disabled and verify sparse matrix shapes and data sizes
test_fetch_rcv1_subset: test fetch_rcv1 with shuffle enabled and subset set to train using a fixed random state
test_fetch_rcv1_return_X_y: test the return_X_y option of fetch_rcv1 to verify it returns X and Y tuples correctly
test_fetch_rcv1_categories: test fetch_rcv1 target category ordering and verify non-zero counts per category
test_fetch_rcv1_consistency: test fetch_rcv1 sample value consistency between unshuffled and shuffled subsets
